### What mouse is this?
Brand and model (the name on the box):

### What do you want to work?
- [ ] See the real DPI change live
- [ ] Set DPI or polling rate from the app
- [ ] Battery level
- [ ] Extra buttons

### Report
Use **Settings → Request support** in Kinetic and it fills this in for you. It holds hardware identifiers and
button layout only: no keystrokes, file paths or account data.
